verdicts.reason: Both break the brand lockup the same way. 'HOHOHO' is split from 'AGENCY' and placed below the 'Office Secret Santa' subtitle, so the name reads in the wrong order. Both also scatter the shapes in a tall column with the bottom shapes cut off at the canvas edge. A is worse: the text block is jammed against the top shapes and the left edge, and the oversized blue ring is cropped at the right and competes with the headline. B spaces the text more evenly and shrinks the ring, though it leaves large empty gaps and the top decorations are tiny.
